metadata.description: Maximum Impact Studio's portable PR workflow skills for coding agents: open a review-ready PR, review one until it's clean, and address reviewer feedback round by round.

plugins.name: open-pr
plugins.description: Build a change in its own worktree, prove it with mutation testing, self-audit, and open a review-ready PR.

plugins.name: review-pr
plugins.description: Review a PR against its full history, post one consolidated comment, and watch for the author's fix.

plugins.name: address-review-comments
plugins.description: Address the latest reviewer batch with a pre-commit self-audit, then commit, push, and reply point-by-point.
